summary: Pair of hikers called 911 after becoming lost near Thomas Lakes (Mt. Sopris area); dispatch texted them directions, Mountain Rescue Aspen arrived around midnight, found the hikers in their tent and escorted them back to the trailhead
notes: Run 625 (Sopris Sun first chunk): date pinned by article 'June 20'/'the same night' + 2023 publication context (Dead Dog/Hunter fires); same article's Crystal River vehicle-in-river mention excluded — occupants self-rescued, no SAR
